body: character reference sheet T-POSE, arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a fantasy knight with BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height (NOT down at the hips, NOT fists at the waist, elbows fully straight, each arm forming a straight horizontal line from the shoulder), both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held, a big visible gap of empty background between each hand and the torso. Big blocky head and a short stubby blocky body made of assembled rectangular blocks (like a voxel-art collectible figure), every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, NO smooth curves, NO soft gradient shading -- each block face a single FLAT solid color with a bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky armor with thick gold trim blocks, a blocky knight helmet with a flat glowing cyan-teal visor rectangle, a short flat cape block on the back only, blocky boots. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos
